agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): removing a shared measurement/validity blocker once in the substrate is cheaper than re-discovering the same MEASUREMENT_INVALID across several lanes.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a frozen/parameterized procedure plus cheap re-observation of volatile state is a plausible way to cut cost per success, but procedure reuse alone does not prove wall-time or dollar savings without a strong cold/retrieval baseline and fully loaded accounting.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): native caching / workflow compilation in capable browser-agent frameworks is a real competitor class, so internal four-arm wins are insufficient for a moat claim without a reproduced external comparator.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): autonomous agent capability degrades sharply at small model sizes and is highly sensitive to tool-protocol/prompt specification, so capability must be certified on the exact chosen endpoint before paying for multi-arm economics.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a persistence result measured from a single network vantage/horizon is not a law; transfer across vantage is the standard identifiability requirement before an observation becomes a product input.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): repair/contamination economics are only meaningful when repair cost is compared against cold re-derivation on the SAME perturbed task, not against a literal non-executing baseline.

allocation.question: On a credential-free, locally served, perturbable HTTP application (NOT the stale distributed nginx/gunicorn/WAL design): with the now-shipped parameterized carrier (src/spider/kernel.py: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify, reference EXP-PRODUCT-38189918141) and the existing deterministic freshness guard, after a controlled LOCAL perturbation (endpoint parameter mutation, selector/structure change, or permission-boundary change), does a local repair restore correct end-to-end task success at a repair cost strictly below cold re-derivation, with ZERO behavioral contamination of unaffected segments (localized write set, contamination rate <= a preregistered bound), against strong baselines (cold re-derive, literal replay, no-repair)? Report the repair-vs-cold cost ratio by perturbation class and the contamination rate, so C-DELTA-REPAIR (the program's only starved claim) is either bounded upward or falsified.
allocation.rationale: C-DELTA-REPAIR has 0 recent packets and rests on a single old bounded positive (EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) whose later attempts were MEASUREMENT_INVALID - the definition of a neglected, newly-reopenable claim. It is the maintenance/repair half of the flagship C-PRODUCT-ECON accounting and becomes genuinely testable now that B1's parameterized carrier is shipped and a deterministic freshness guard exists. Decision counterfactual: if repair beats cold re-derivation under a contamination bound, the maintenance model in the gated benchmark gets a real cost term; if it cannot, we drop local-repair from the product story before paying for a flagship run. If it succeeds/fails/cannot-measure, the next choice changes (promote repair into the treatment arm vs. remove it). Marginal value of another semantic-resolution split is low; marginal value of the starved claim is high. This is a genuine supersede of the inherited held-out generalization direction, not a rerun: the frozen substrate is credential-free, local and perturbable, and the comparators are cold re-derive / replay / no-repair rather than a synthetic single-environment ceiling.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Program map: 449 canonical experiments; the 60-recent window carries ~43.3% REVISE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID friction and Physics carries 0.70 friction over its last 10. The global synthesis confirms a program that produces evidence but no validated external-agent product: no experiment establishes net end-to-end cost reduction per successful partially-novel Web task against cold/instructions/retrieval under a shared model/tools/budget. Of the three decisive blockers, B1 (shipped parameterized carrier) is now DISCHARGED (distill_parameterized promoted into src/spider/kernel.py); B2 (non-degenerate task bank) is IN PROGRESS on the Runtime prefreeze V3 bank; B3 (capable same-protocol endpoint/economics) is UNRESOLVED. Priorities this cycle: (1) complete the two already-frozen transactions before any redirection - Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-38188815194 and Intel EXP-INTEL-38194362040 - because aborting them wastes sunk frozen design and neither is a duplicate; (2) fund the Runtime prefreeze V3 bank because it is the shared measurement-validity prerequisite gating the whole flagship comparison; (3) reactivate the two IDLE lanes (Graph, Product) - Graph onto the program's only starved claim C-DELTA-REPAIR (0 recent packets) rather than a third incremental semantic-resolution split, and Product onto safe support-widening of the now-shipped carrier so the treatment arm is competitive BEFORE any gated benchmark; (4) keep Physics on the inherited prefreeze second-egress transfer test but hard-gate it on a pre-freeze attainability certificate, because generality of the valid single-vantage access-barrier result is the only open Physics question with real decision value and a second futile single-vantage run must be forbidden; (5) redirect Intel from the 3-prior-falsified credential-free local-GGUF capability branch to reproducing a competitor-strength external comparator (Stagehand-style native caching and/or compile-and-execute), which is constitutionally required to make ANY market-level C-PRODUCT-ECON claim and is credential-free and non-duplicative. I explicitly do NOT fund the full four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark: readiness conditions (2) and (3) are still missing, so every lane allocation below removes a blocker instead. Opportunity cost honored: no lane is asked to run the same mechanism again at higher n, and Graph/Product idle capacity is spent on starved claims rather than more of the same.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout correctly identified the three blockers and that B1 is discharged while B2/B3 remain, and it correctly flagged Physics's high friction and the risk of another unsatisfiable second-vantage run. I adopted its (a) hard pre-freeze egress-attainability condition on Physics (otherwise PARK, no futile single-vantage substitution) and (b) redirection of the credential-free local-GGUF Intel branch whose capability premise was falsified three times. I challenged two Scout suggestions: I did NOT let the idle Graph lane burn another cycle on the semantic-resolution held-out split (the -0.05 miss is a single-split artifact and the claim is already EXPERIMENTAL), because the program's only starved claim C-DELTA-REPAIR (0 recent packets) is more neglected and feeds the maintenance half of C-PRODUCT-ECON; and I did NOT re-spec the stale, over-specified distributed nginx/gunicorn/WAL C-DELTA-REPAIR prereg that already produced MEASUREMENT_INVALID, instead mandating a credential-free locally-perturbable substrate. I also treated Scout's note that the headless credential-free defaults are ~0.5B models as a reason to keep Intel OFF the four-arm benchmark and ON a credential-free comparator reproduction. Where Scout and I differ on filing, I kept Runtime's bank under C-MEAS-VALID (eligible under its charter) while stating its cross-lane purpose in the question, so the B2 prerequisite remains legible to Product/Intel.
